# Contract check: the immediate-return remember

**Date:** 2026-04-06
**Participants:** Wynn Castellano (Staff Engineer)

Wynn: "We ratified the async job contract: remember returns a receipt in
seconds and the extraction is watched by polling a cursor. No blocking
call, and no lost work if the client drops the receipt."

Key decision: remember dispatches, then the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call.

positions.name: AsyncRememberContract
positions.frame: When the async job contract for remember is invoked — ratified guarantee to the caller, or dispatch-and-poll mechanism the agent follows — what exactly is being fixed?
positions.why: Both expressions describe the same ratified contract — remember dispatches immediately, returns fast, and the actual extraction is tracked without a blocking call — and both carry decision-grade conviction (a settled, load-bearing statement acted on going forward), in the same native technical register (receipt, cursor, polling, piggyback used without scaffolding). But the read holds them in tension rather than resolving them: src-1 performs the ratification communally ('We ratified') as a concrete, realis guarantee to the caller (no blocking, no lost work), while src-2 frames it as an authority-ranked 'Key decision' specifying the agent's abstract operational choreography (poll vs. piggyback) — and src-2's footing (animator/author Xena ExpertGH, principal left unresolved) leaves open whose decision is actually being asserted, unlike src-1's plain collective ratification.

placements.why: Both expressions ratify and specify a structural contract governing how remember executes — immediate dispatch, receipt issuance, and async completion tracking — which is organizational-architecture-grain content with no existing strata category to hold it.
placements.title: System behavior is fixed at the level of dispatch and completion contracts, not just features
placements.frame: Does this content name a structural guarantee about how the system executes and completes work, rather than a feature or a one-time result?

placements.title: remember shifts from a synchronous call to an async dispatch that returns a receipt and defers completion
placements.frame: When remember is invoked, what is actually being guaranteed to the caller — an immediate receipt with no blocking, or the mechanism (poll vs. piggyback) by which the deferred extraction result eventually surfaces?
placements.why: src-1 ratifies the contract as a concrete caller-facing guarantee (receipt in seconds, no blocking call, no lost work) and src-2 restates it as the operational choreography the agent follows (dispatch, then poll or piggyback) — both are the same directional theme of remember as async-dispatch-with-deferred-completion, a subject future envelopes about this contract will keep feeding, not a one-time fact.
